synopsis: Unreal Engine appears as an environment-creation platform across Falcon, CARLA and MathWorks; their editors are described as domain-neutral, with differing licenses, prices and latest releases [f8358, f9157, f9158, f9160, f9161]. CARLA 0.10.0 migrated to Unreal Engine 5.5 with Chaos physics on 19 December 2024 and included a mining earth-mover asset, while CARLA 0.9.16 was subsequently released on the Unreal Engine 4 line on 16 September 2025 [f8464, f8297, f8466]. MathWorks supports construction, mining and agriculture applications through Unreal scenes exposing camera, lidar and INS, while AGX Dynamics offers Unreal and Unity plugins [f8374, f8380, f8571]. Chapter 5 reports a 2023 Unreal-based excavator perception pipeline, but identifies all its listed construction and excavation examples as camera-centric, limiting their evidence for broader sensor validation [f4132, f4137]. The recommended middle-cost stack combines Unreal with MATLAB/Simulink and off-road tooling, with Mevea or AGX coupled through FMI for terrain, hydraulics and machine variants; establishing capability also requires dynamics, sensor, automation and safety expertise beyond rendering skills [f9285, f16162, f8773].
